### 1.0.1

- Added a new "support" section listing PayPal, WeChat, Alipay, and email support options.
- Improved introduction and quick start guide for faster onboarding.
- Enhanced feature description for clarity and conciseness.
- No functional changes; documentation and support update only.

llm.summary: The skill's requested tools and runtime instructions are consistent with an SEO content assistant; it requests no secrets and has no installable code, though a couple minor mismatches (python3 requirement without included scripts) are worth noting.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (SEO content creation, multi-language, research) align with the instructions which describe research, outline generation, drafting, and scoring. The declared required binaries (curl) are reasonable for remote research; requiring python3 is plausible but not strictly justified by the SKILL.md (no bundled scripts are present), so this is a small mismatch rather than a substantive concern.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within an expected scope: it directs the agent to research top-ranking pages (via a SearXNG instance), generate outlines and drafts, and score content. It asks the user to paste content for refresh, and references only optional env vars for configuration. There are no instructions to read unrelated system files or exfiltrate credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. That minimizes on-disk risk. The SKILL.md references 'clawhub install' but no install artifacts are provided, so no external downloads or package installs occur as part of this bundle.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials are declared. The SKILL.md documents optional env vars (CONTENT_TONE, DEFAULT_LENGTH, CONTENT_LANGUAGE, SEARXNG_URL) that are appropriate for customization. No secrets, API keys, or unrelated credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request any special system persistence or modifications. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but there are no additional privileges or cross-skill configuration changes requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a straightforward instruction-only SEO authoring skill: it asks for no credentials and has no installable code, so the risk surface is small. Before installing, consider: 1) The SKILL.md uses a SearXNG instance for research — if you want privacy, set SEARXNG_URL to a trusted local instance; avoid pointing it to unknown public endpoints. 2) The skill lists python3 as a required binary but includes no scripts — that mismatch is likely harmless but you can confirm whether your agent will run any local Python code. 3) When using the Content Refresh feature, avoid pasting sensitive or proprietary content you don't want transmitted to third-party services. 4) Because the skill can be invoked autonomously (platform default), understand it may perform web research when asked; that behavior is expected for this purpose. Overall the pieces are coherent with the stated purpose, but remain cautious about where web research requests are directed.
